verdict.rationale: Community reports say Fastmail can be set up to fetch mail from, and send via, Gmail like a mail client, and that its Gmail integration ingests mail and calendars well. That is a product-native way to work an external Gmail account inside Fastmail. The other docs are bare titles: 'Import your mail' points to a one-off migration and 'Logging in to multiple accounts' to switching between Fastmail logins, so neither shows ongoing aggregation of other providers. Missing for 10: first-party docs for ongoing external-account fetching, Microsoft 365 support, generic IMAP account support, evidence of working several external accounts at once from a unified view.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place

citations.quote: you can configure Fastmail to fetch mail from (and send via) Gmail like a mail client
The Gmail integration for ingesting mail and calendars works fantastically.
